text.p: A total of 20 clubs or provinces from England, Wales, Scotland, Ireland, France and Italy will be involved in the European Cup, which kicks off on Saturday.
European Cup:
Pool A - Bath (England), Dax (France), Edinburgh (Scotland), Pontypridd (Wales), Treviso (Italy).
Pool B - Leicester (England), Leinster (Ireland), Llanelli (Wales), Pau (France), Scottish Borders (Scotland).
Pool C - Brive (France), Caledonia (Scotland), Harlequins (England), Neath (Wales), Ulster (Ireland).
Pool D - Cardiff (Wales), Milan (Italy), Munster (Ireland), Toulouse (France), Wasps (England).
Fixtures:
Pool A
Oct 12 Pontypridd v Treviso, Bath v Edinburgh
Oct 16 Treviso v Dax, Edinburgh v Pontypridd
Oct 19 Dax v Edinburgh, Pontypridd v Bath
Oct 26 Bath v Dax, Edinburgh v Treviso
Nov 2 Dax v Pontypridd, Treviso v Bath
Pool B
Oct 12 Llanelli v Leinster, Pau v Scottish Borders
Oct 16 Leinster v Leicester, Scottish Borders v Llanelli
Oct 19 Leicester v Scottish Borders, Llanelli v Pau
Oct 26 Pau v Leicester, Scottish Borders v Leinster
Nov 2 Leicester v Llanelli, Leinster v Pau
Pool C
Oct 12 Brive v Neath
Oct 13 Caledonia v Ulster
Oct 16 Ulster v Harlequins, Neath v Caledonia
Oct 19 Harlequins v Neath, Caledonia v Brive
Oct 26 Brive v Harlequins, Neath v Ulster
Nov 2 Harlequins v Caledonia, Ulster v Brive
Pool D
Oct 12 Munster v Milan
Oct 13 Wasps v Cardiff
Oct 16 Milan v Toulouse, Cardiff v Munster
Oct 19 Toulouse v Cardiff, Munster v Wasps
Oct 26 Wasps v Toulouse, Cardiff v Milan
Nov 2 Toulouse v Munster, Milan v Wasps
Quarter-finals: November 16/17
Semifinals: January 4/5, 1997
Final: To be announced
The European Conference, a second-tier tournament featuring 24 clubs from seven countries, also begins on Saturday. Competing teams are listed below:
Pool A - Agen (France), Glasgow (Scotland), Montferrand (France), Newbridge (Wales), Newport (Wales), Sale (England).
Pool B - Bridgend (Wales), Bristol (England), Castres (France), Dinamo Bucharest (Romania), Narbonne (France), Treorchy (Wales).
Pool C - Connacht (Ireland), Dunvant (Wales), Northampton (England), Orrell (England), Padova (Italy), Toulon (France).
Pool D - Begles (France), Bourgoin (France), Ebbw Vale (Wales), Gloucester (England), London Irish, Swansea (Wales).
